observations: Charati selects repeated or habitual engagement. Tattva excludes the accidental performance in either direction.

The older general discussion at 1.1.72 cites the nañ+dharma case under a specific proposal which makes the local supplement unnecessary on that account.
Nyāsa also supplies the previous ca with an unexpressed-member function.
Padamañjarī and Bāla require the separate stipulation under their literal-stem condition. The contrary meaning is active misconduct.
Kāśikā gives two printed agent-stems and explains n-it versus k-it. Nyāsa states distribution and orientation of the path context.
The avyayībhāva’s stem belongs to a pathin-final compound with the separate a samāsānta.
Nyāsa raw pratipadhikam and prātipadika display against Kāśikā’s phonemic pair are recorded as text issues.
